PS_safety.impact_of_the_change: On the partial-miss answered path (M>=1), compile-current-state now OVERWRITES the (positionally-pickable) stock last_result_set with the dym candidates and arms selection_context='suggest_offer', WHILE leaving variables.response = 'Previous turn (inventory): returned N records' unchanged. So (a) a following bare number that today resolves a STOCK row now resolves a DYM candidate (behavior change on a live affordance), and (b) a NEW mis-resolution surface is created: the compressed response still advertises 'N records' (stock count) to the parser while last_result_set holds the M dym candidates, so a customer referencing stock-record-K by number gets dym-candidate-K. No guard prevents either.
PS_safety.plan_claim_refuted: Plan §2.4 / UAC §PS-1 verified-claim-B / plan Claim B assert the repurpose 'regresses nothing that was ever pickable' because '_pickCtx requires selection_context in {disambiguation,suggest_offer} or a quote-reply'. That is FALSE for the positional resolution: output_exchange's byIdx block is NOT gated by _pickCtx. The safety rationale does not hold.
required_fix_options_for_planner_coder: Do NOT repurpose last_result_set on the answered path; use a separate namespaced pick slot the positional/byIdx path does not read; OR
When arming the dym pick, also REWRITE variables.response so the parser no longer sees 'returned N records' (so a bare number is not classified positionally against the now-dym last_result_set); OR

Add an explicit guard/selection_context distinct from the stock positional path and update output_exchange to disambiguate — i.e. the guard the HALT calls for. Any option must be re-gated by a fresh §PS-safety.
